correctness.rationale: For every n>=1, the cyclic difference map x_i XOR x_{i+3} has kernel 2^{gcd(n,3)} and image the g independent even-parity shift-orbit constraints. Character projection yields four explicit 4x4 signed transfer traces, whose exact determinant polynomials produce the formal zeta series and divisor-based primitive-necklace count. An independent exact 32x32 characteristic-polynomial calculation verifies the all-length identity; brute enumeration agrees through n=17. The proof covers n<6 by periodic extension, not by linear counts.

value.rationale: The family is a natural fixed-block tandem-duplication exclusion model for circular words, not an arbitrary finite slice. The all-length exact polynomial resolves the periodic-point enumeration, removes rotation multiplicity via primitive necklaces, and proves a concrete tribonacci growth law. The cyclic parity constraints introduce a structural distinction from the prior linear theory. No large-system coding gain or experimental biological efficacy is claimed.
